title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: The Cube at Morgan Library
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Glass-Walled Study Space
cards.notes: Access this two-story glass-walled study space 24/7 with your RamCard. It offers natural light and views of the LSC Plaza for late-night or early-morning sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour glass-walled study pavilion attached to the Morgan Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Study Cube is a two-story building attached to the Morgan Library with full-length glass walls and 24/7 student access.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students with RamCard access.

cards.title: The Great Hall at TILT
cards.subtitle: Historic Reading Room Environment
cards.notes: Study in CSU's original library reading room. This historic space features high ceilings and serves as a hub for tutoring and the Calculus Center.
cards.short_summary: A historic, high-ceilinged study hall located in the Institute for Learning and Teaching building.
cards.evidence_claim: First the Reading Room in CSU's original stand-alone library... the Great Hall is now a beautiful place to study and take advantage of the Calculus Center and TILT Tutoring.
cards.source_title: Great Hall | The Institute for Learning and Teaching - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Open during TILT building hours, typically Monday-Friday.

cards.title: Kindness Lounge
cards.subtitle: Sunken Lounge with Fireplace
cards.notes: Find a spot by the two-story rock fireplace in this sunken, carpeted lounge. Large windows provide ample natural light for daytime reading.
cards.short_summary: A cozy, centrally located lounge in the Lory Student Center featuring a large fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: With walls of windows, a sunken, carpeted floor, and a two-story rock fireplace, the Diane Warren Kindness Lounge in the Lory Student Center has all the good vibes.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the 200 level of the Lory Student Center; open during building hours.

cards.entity_name: Michael Smith Natural Resources Building Lounge
cards.title: The Living Wall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Nature-Inspired Atrium Study
cards.notes: Study beside a multi-story living wall in the Michael Smith addition. This LEED-certified space features 'treehouse' meeting rooms and natural wood accents.
cards.short_summary: A modern, sustainable study lounge featuring a vertical garden and natural light.
cards.evidence_claim: The Michael Smith Natural Resources Building addition... includes flex conference space, living wall, extended atrium, and features treehouse meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: MICHAEL SMITH NATURAL RESOURCES BUILDING ADDITION - 4240 Architecture
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible during Warner College of Natural Resources building hours.

cards.title: BSB Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable Tech-Equipped Rooms
cards.notes: Reserve one of these modern rooms through the library portal for up to 3 hours. They are equipped with whiteboards and screens for group collaboration.
cards.short_summary: Private, reservable group study rooms located in the Behavioral Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms in the BSB can be reserved from the CSU libraries website... in thirty minute time blocks from 7:30AM to 11:30PM.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Study Room - Exploratory Technology Resource Center
cards.access_notes: Reservable by CSU students; rooms available 7:30 AM to 11:30 PM.

cards.title: Scott 24-Hour Atrium
cards.subtitle: North Campus Study Hub
cards.notes: Utilize this 24-hour study area in the three-story atrium. It serves as a major study hub for the north side of campus with plenty of seating and outlets.
cards.short_summary: A large, 24-hour accessible atrium study space in the Scott Bioengineering Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Key components of this building are: A 24-hour study area within the three-story atrium that is open to all CSU students.
cards.source_title: Suzanne and Walter Scott, Jr. Bioengineering Building | University Facility Fee Advisory Board
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for all CSU students.

cards.title: Biology Building Nooks
cards.subtitle: Modern Science-Focused Seating
cards.notes: Find quiet seating areas throughout this newer building. Reservable group rooms are also available for up to 4 hours per day via the library system.
cards.short_summary: Modern study areas and reservable rooms within the CSU Biology Building.
cards.evidence_claim: The new Colorado State University Biology Building offers welcoming study spaces... Rooms can be reserved for a maximum of 4 hours per day.
cards.source_title: Room Reservation – Department of Biology | CSU
cards.access_notes: Building open Monday-Friday 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM; study rooms reservable via library portal.

cards.title: RDC Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: Interdisciplinary Maker Environment
cards.notes: Work in open, flexible layouts designed to increase social interaction. The third floor features dedicated collaboration spaces for design-focused projects.
cards.short_summary: Creative and collaborative study spaces within the Nancy Richardson Design Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Our three-story building houses... Collaboration spaces... Open, flexible layouts to increase social interactions and creative collaboration.
cards.source_title: Nancy Richardson Design Center Our Building - College of Health and Human Sciences
cards.access_notes: Open during RDC building hours; check college website for specific lab access.

cards.title: University Club Lounge
cards.subtitle: Quiet Lodge-Style Retreat
cards.notes: Escape to the top floor of the LSC for a 'lodge vibe' with cushioned armchairs and couches. It is typically quieter than the lower, high-traffic floors.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, lodge-style lounge located on the upper level of the Lory Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Club is a lounge adjacent to the Aspen Grille, and it boasts a cozy lodge vibe, complete with cushioned armchairs and big couches.
cards.source_title: 8 study spots on campus for every type of student | Admissions - Colorado State University
cards.access_notes: Located on the 300 level of the Lory Student Center; open during building hours.

cards.title: Morgan Library Quiet Level
cards.subtitle: Deep Silence Study Zone
cards.notes: Head to the basement for the library's quietest environment. This level features a range of individual and group study rooms available by reservation.
cards.short_summary: The designated quietest level of the Morgan Library, featuring reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Morgan Library Layout: – Basement: Offers a range of study rooms you can reserve (Quietest Level).
cards.source_title: On-Campus Study Spaces - Peer-to-Peer Resources for CSU Community - WordPress.com
cards.access_notes: Open during Morgan Library hours; typically 9 AM to 11 PM Sunday-Thursday.
